text:
rachel: Short quarterly synthesis from the postmortem rollups. Three persistent recurrence signals: prefix-cache cold fills during rapid model swaps, scale-thrash on burst cooldowns, and short mesh retransmits between regions. Posting counts, a compact query, and proposed owners.

evan: Thanks — what timeframe and counts?

rachel: Window 2025-11-01..2026-03-31. Tallies: prefix-cache=21, scale-thrash=13, mesh-retransmit=8. Query I ran (sanitized):```sql
SELECT root_cause, COUNT(1) cnt
FROM incidents
WHERE created_at >= '2025-11-01' AND created_at <= '2026-03-31'
AND tags @> ARRAY['postmortem']
GROUP BY root_cause
ORDER BY cnt DESC;
```

pablo: prefix-cache cold fills 1 - any model family or session pattern?

rachel: Mostly heavy-context families and multi-swap sessions (swap-count >2 in <60s). Some incidents align with weight promos to Dedicated pools.

ops-bot: ops-bot created INF-8001 "prefix-cache cold fills: counters + adaptive prefetch"

mina: Proposed owners: pablo -> prefix-cache counters & adaptive prefetch (PoC 10bd), evan -> autoscaler dampening + canary (RFC 6bd), callie -> mesh retransmit smoothing + obs (8bd). Agree?

evan: I can take autoscaler. Plan: add a short moving average window (30s), cap scale-down velocity to 20%/min, and add a swap-protect flag to avoid aggressive downscales during detected swaps. Will draft RFC and run perf replays. Target RFC in 5 business days.

pablo: For prefix-cache I'll add metric prefix.cache.hit_v1 sharded by model_version+deployment and a prefix.cache.cold_fill counter. PoC adaptive prefetch that warms the top-K models (budgeted per deployment) in 10 business days; full mitigation + CI smoke in 3 weeks. Will guard to avoid extra load.

callie: Mesh retransmit plan: jittered backoff + per-route circuit breakers and a transient sticky-route for 30s to avoid immediate failover. Add metrics: mesh.retransmit_rate and swap.tail95. Target initial canary in 8 business days.

mina: I'll own consolidated runbook updates and the customer-impact classification for Dedicated tenants. Also adding a new postmortem tag recurrence:swap-cache to help future rollups.

rachel: Action items recap: INF-8001 pablo 1 prefix-cache counters + prefetch (PoC 10bd, mitigation 21bd); INF-8002 evan 1 autoscaler dampening RFC + canary (RFC 5bd); INF-8003 callie 1 mesh retransmit smoothing + obs (8bd). I scheduled a checkpoint here in two weeks.

evan: Small ask: give me perf-harness and a traffic-replay id for the RFC tests. I'll try a small real-traffic replay first.

pablo: Note on metrics cardinality: we'll TTL per-model counters to 60d and only persist top-N models by swap-volume; others will be sampled. Adding that to INF-8001.

ops-bot: reminder-bot scheduled a follow-up checkpoint in #incidents in 14 days for thread 2193456789

rachel: Thanks all. Please update ticket lanes with PR links, CI job configs, and perf replay IDs. We'll validate success by targeting a >=50% reduction in recurrence count over 30 days post-mitigation. Closing until the checkpoint. :white_check_mark:
